title: VPAA v1: Cloud Security in the UK
objectives: Understand the legal requirements for cloud security in the UK
Configure AWS IAM to enforce least privilege access
Implement encryption at rest and in transit using AWS services
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of cloud computing and AWS
Understanding of data protection principles (UK GDPR)
Familiarity with Linux command line interface

mission_brief.briefing: Aegis Logistics requires a team of cloud security experts to design and implement a secure cloud infrastructure for their operations. They need to comply with the UK GDPR and Computer Misuse Act 1990.
rules_of_engagement: Collaborate with Aegis Logistics stakeholders to understand their requirements
Design and implement a secure cloud architecture that meets UK GDPR and CMA 1990 compliance
Provide training and documentation for Aegis Logistics staff on cloud security best practices

content.concept: Cloud security is critical in today's digital landscape. In the UK, organisations must comply with data protection principles (UK GDPR) and prevent unauthorised access to computer material (Computer Misuse Act 1990). A secure cloud infrastructure ensures confidentiality, integrity, and availability of sensitive data.
content.walkthrough: In this lesson, we will configure AWS IAM to enforce least privilege access using Identity and Access Management roles. We will also implement encryption at rest using Amazon S3 bucket policies and in transit using SSL/TLS certificates with Elastic Load Balancers.
checkpoints: Verify least privilege access for all users
Implement encryption at rest for sensitive data stored in Amazon S3 buckets
Configure Elastic Load Balancers to use SSL/TLS certificates
common_mistakes: Not configuring IAM roles correctly, leading to unauthorised access
Forgetting to enable encryption at rest or in transit
Failing to monitor and audit cloud security logs

lab.setup: Create an AWS account and configure the command line interface using `aws configure`.
steps: Step 1: Create IAM roles for users with least privilege access
Step 2: Implement encryption at rest using Amazon S3 bucket policies
Step 3: Configure Elastic Load Balancers to use SSL/TLS certificates
Step 4: Verify that all steps have been completed successfully
Step 5: Document the secure cloud infrastructure design

validate.expected: A list of users with least privilege access

safety: Be cautious when using the AWS command line interface to avoid accidental modifications
Regularly back up AWS configuration and security logs
Monitor cloud security logs for any suspicious activity

elite_competence.role_simulation: Cloud Security Architect at Aegis Logistics

bug_injection.description: A malicious actor has compromised a user's IAM credentials, granting them elevated access to the cloud infrastructure.
bug_injection.bad_state: The attacker is using the compromised credentials to modify critical cloud resources.

success_criteria.expected_output: The role's policies and permissions have been updated to prevent unauthorised access

interrogation_questions: What are the key differences between IAM roles and instance profiles?
How do you implement encryption at rest using Amazon S3 bucket policies?
What are the best practices for monitoring cloud security logs?

accessibility.alt_text_summary: This lesson covers cloud security in the UK, including legal requirements and best practices for implementing a secure cloud infrastructure.

resume_bullets: Configured AWS IAM to enforce least privilege access using Identity and Access Management roles
Implemented encryption at rest using Amazon S3 bucket policies
Documented the secure cloud infrastructure design
